force_measurement_convention.historical_stored_50: The 280 search records and dose/perturbation summaries used a threshold of 50 on the original heel-plus-toe signal. Each level-ground contact was counted twice, so the physical model threshold was 25 N. The experimental reference threshold was 50 N.
force_measurement_convention.single_counted_50_N: physical_angle_comparison.json reports a matched-threshold reduction of the original trajectories. The later three-objective search is in pareto_reference.
